title: Pinnate
summary: PIN'NATE PIN'NATED, adjective [Latin pinnatus, from pinna, a fether or fin.] In botany, a pinnate leaf is a species of compound leaf wherein a simple petiole has several leaflets attached to each side

inlines.v: PIN'NATE PIN'NATED, adjective [Latin pinnatus, from pinna, a fether or fin.] In botany, a pinnate leaf is a species of compound leaf wherein a simple petiole has several leaflets attached to each side of it.
